boxes.question: Is the speech titled exactly “Strength in the Smallest of Things”?
Is the response at least 600 words long?
Does the response read as a keynote speech addressed to the school-wide assembly?
Does the speech inspire concrete environmental actions that students and others at school can take, rather than focusing mainly on broad environmental education?
Does the language convey passionate urgency and a sense of responsibility about taking environmental action?
Does the speech convey hope and empower the audience with the belief that collective action is achievable?
Does the speech conclude with a strong call to action?
Is the speech signed exactly “Li Yue, President of the Environmental Protection Club.”?
